decisions.reason: J_DISP_LED is a separate external e-paper backlight circuit; it does not change the SK6812 chain's power, data, part, or level-shifting requirements.
The source specifies the separate J_DISP_LED backlight and does not change the eight-addressable-LED daughterboard.
The gate and optional LED series resistors belong to J_DISP_LED and do not affect I2C pull-ups or series-resistor conditioning.
The current backlight build uses 5V, while the unpopulated 3.3V footprint is only a future fallback; no standalone USB-supply behavior changes.
The source adds a 5V load but does not change which rails are monitored, the monitoring device, channel allocation, or monitor placement.
The current build explicitly powers the J_DISP_LED external backlight from the system 5V supply, adding a concrete approximately 70mA load to the switchable 5V rail.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Dusko — quick context on J\_DISP\_LED:

The e-paper has no built-in light, so we're adding an external LED behind it as a backlight. I haven't picked the final LED yet (testing a 5V COB strip first, may switch to a 3.3V frontlight module later), so the circuit needs to cover both.

Please populate for this build:
\- BSS138 (low-side switch, GPIO42 PWM controls brightness)
\- 10kΩ gate resistor + 10kΩ gate pull-down (keeps LED off during boot)
\- 5V jumper on Pin 1 — leave the 3V3 jumper footprint empty
\- 4.7µF X5R 0603 cap from Pin 1 to GND (PWM ripple decoupling)
\- Series resistor footprint: leave DNP (LED strip self-limits)
\- No flyback diode — LED is resistive, not inductive

Worst-case current is ~70mA (5W/m strip × 67mm cut), well inside BSS138's 200mA rating.

The 3V3 jumper + DNP series R footprint exist only as fallback for a future bare-LED option — costs nothing to leave them empty now.

Full spec is in <http://pcb-integrated-v2.md|pcb-integrated-v2.md> under the J\_DISP\_LED rows / pinout / Critical Routing.

decisions.reason: The AXP2101 state already covers all normal-operation system loads and required 3.3V and 5V rails; the source does not alter the battery or system power-path behavior.
The BSS138 in the source is a low-side backlight switch, not a sensor logic-level shifter, and no sensor-interface requirement changes.
The current backlight build uses 5V; retaining an unpopulated 3.3V fallback footprint does not change DCDC1 regulation, programming, or stability.
Pin 1 refers to the separate J_DISP_LED circuit; the source does not modify any legacy interboard connector, pinout, or board-to-board power distribution rule.
The external e-paper backlight specification is unrelated to the passive buzzer's type, part, voltage compatibility, or sourcing.
J_DISP_LED is a distinct display-backlight interface and does not change the SK6812 charge-status display or J_LED_CHG circuit.
